name: M11-NOV-01a1 maintained-path public prior-art fixture discovery
purpose: Screen source-backed public draft/PMID pairs for a relevant first page in the current novelty retrieval path; these exploratory calls cannot establish candidate improvement.

cases_in_call_order.draft: In motor neurons with TDP-43 dysfunction, use of a cryptic STMN2 polyadenylation signal produces truncated transcripts and limits axonal repair.
In airway epithelial cells, reducing TMPRSS2 activity should decrease ACE2-dependent infection by SARS-CoV-2 spike-bearing virus.
Interferon-rich tumors increase Qa-1b ligand display, engaging inhibitory NKG2A/CD94 on cytotoxic CD8 cells and weakening antitumor killing.

request_contract.path: Current configured pubmed_fulltext ToolConfig mapped to the maintained pubmed_search_with_fulltext MCP tool and parsed with its ResponseParser; no direct Entrez substitute.
request_contract.query: exact draft[:200] for each case; no rewrite, extra term, date filter or retry
request_contract.on_first_error_or_rate_limit: stop; retain partial results and upstream class without trying another provider or query

runtime_boundary.credentials: no inherited environment, no API keys, no paid plugins or metered tools; the maintained MCP source has no colocated .env at registration

screening_rule: A case is eligible for later freezing only if the target PMID appears among the first three parsed IDs and primary-source abstract review confirms the retrieved paper supports the draft's central mechanism. A nonempty but off-topic page fails. These target-conditioned discovery results may not be reported as an unbiased candidate-versus-baseline win.
later_acceptance: After screening, separately freeze the final positive/control order, labels, target IDs, full-validator request/evaluation boundary, static-query control, exact-ID recall, control non-rejection, provenance, error handling and two-search/six-paper cap before any candidate implementation or paired comparison.
